claim_ceiling: A B2 pass can establish only fixed-suite ideal software-convention agreement on five prespecified native-gate circuits between a SiliQun source export and a separately written SiVQD evaluator. It is not a general equivalence proof, hardware evidence, named-device calibration, calibrated SiMOS-noise evidence, pulse validation, QEC evidence, a SiMORA runtime input, or an algorithm execution result.
